name: Final Words

stealth.details: (trained) to hear the scratch of a quill upon paper

disable: DC 24 Religion check (trained) to ward off the haunt or DC 25 Thievery check (trained) to dispose of the letter with extreme care before the haunt can form

items.name: Carve in Flesh
items.text:
Trigger A creature reads the letter

---

Effect The haunt deals 2d8+11 slashing damage to the triggering creature as the words are carved into its flesh (DC 21 basic Will save). On a failure, the creature takes 2d8 bleed.

text: As a creature touches a hand-written letter, they witness the letter's author scribe it in the past; each pen stroke across the page carves the letter's text into the creature's flesh.
